text: Moses, man of God, blessed the People of Israel with this blessing before his death.
God came down from Sinai, he dawned from Seir upon them; He radiated light from Mount Paran, coming with ten thousand holy angels And tongues of fire streaming from his right hand.

"Listen, God, to the Voice of Judah, bring him to his people; Strengthen his grip, be his helper against his foes."
"Let your Thummim and Urim belong to your loyal saint; The one you tested at Massah, whom you fought with at the Waters of Meribah,
'I no longer recognize them.' He turned his back on his brothers and neglected his children, Because he was guarding your sayings and watching over your Covenant.
and your Revelation to Israel, Let him keep the incense rising to your nostrils and the Whole-Burnt-Offerings on your Altar.
stamp your seal of approval on what he does; Disable the loins of those who defy him, make sure we've heard the last from those who hate him."
"God's beloved; God's permanent residence. Encircled by God all day long, within whom God is at home."
"Blessed by God be his land: The best fresh dew from high heaven, and fountains springing from the depths;
and the best the moon has to offer;
and the best from the everlasting hills;
the smile of the Burning-Bush Dweller. All this on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the consecrated one among his brothers.
